description: R-Drop paired-view categorical objective: sum the two cross-entropies and add alpha times the half-sum bidirectional KL (paper Section 2.1, Equations (2)-(4)); concatenate the two views as [view1_B; view2_B] per Algorithm 1 in Section 2.2. Structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-48.

examples.title: Train a paired-view classifier with R-Drop

name: R-Drop paired-view categorical loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only alpha; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.alpha: finite nonnegative coefficient for the symmetric KL term (default 1.0; paper Section 2.1, Equation (4))
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index excluded from both views and the mean denominator (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point logits shaped [2*B,C], with the first B rows for view 1 and the next B rows for view 2; B positive and C at least two
parameters.reduction: none returns one objective per example, mean averages nonignored examples, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer class-index tensor shaped [B], matching each view; finite integer-valued floating tensors are also accepted; values are in [0,C) except for ignore_index
